posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Now, I'll be the first to admit that I'm not the greatest Sentinels player in the world. But I know my way around the decks, and have played many times in person and I've played the video game A LOT.  Going into a battle, I'm reasonably confident that I'll at least hold my own.

 

That said, I've now lost my last THREE battles with Baron Blade! I hit randomize, go in thinking " well, this won't take too long..." Only to be surprised by the ill-timed devious disruption, or stinking double backlash fields or what have you. After the second defeat, I chose Blade for a rematch....only to witness Fixer, Expatriette and Absolute Zero allowing the the Baron to pull the moon into the Earth. Sheesh.

 

Guess you've got my number on this day, Ramonat.

 

Tomorrow? That's a different story. (I hope!)

I'm sure you'll all be relieved to know that Blade did NOT prevail the fourth time.

 

TLT, grandpa Legacy, Omnitron X and Dark Visionary (I wasn't taking any chances) flattened Blade in the block.

 

Only Legacy took damage, and that was because he played Take Down twice.

 

Whew! Now I can move on.
